name: chart
title: Chart
description: Generic chart wrapper that consumes Lumen's CHART_PALETTE and chart-token surface (axes, grid, legend, tooltip). Eleven kinds via the `kind` enum — line / area / bar / stacked-bar / donut / pie / scatter / heatmap / sparkline / funnel / waterfall. Renders via the consumer's adapter (Recharts, Visx, ECharts) but the styling, axis layout, legend, and tooltip skin come from Lumen.
